CustomField.description: The Work_Item__c picklist value this external value means, e.g. In Progress. Must match the picklist API name exactly - Status__c and Type__c are restricted, so a typo here does not fail loudly, it quietly stops mapping and the record lands on Unspecified. Not required since build 09, for Maps To Blank rows only: an empty value without that checkbox is a half-filled row and maps nothing.
CustomField.label: Normalized Value
